ops.text: Two concurrent `great-docs build` runs in the same checkout race on the shared `great-docs/` scratch (freeze cache, generated `_quarto.yml`, temp `_site`): one run cleans/recreates the working dir while the other's Quarto/griffe step is chdir'd inside it, so the second crashes with `getcwd: cannot access parent directories: No such file or directory` at a nondeterministic step (observed Step 15 API-reference one run, Step 16/17 freeze+Quarto the next; ~6min in). The victim's own shell cwd is untouched, so the failure looks like a content/anchor error but isn't — it's an infra collision. In this shared cc-pool checkout (multiple acct-* sessions build docs at once) `great-docs build` needs a per-invocation working/freeze dir or a build lock; until then, serialize docs builds (wait for other `great-docs build` PIDs to clear before running). Standalone `quarto render <page>.qmd` is a race-free way to validate individual page content meanwhile.
